Essential Content Plan

EGP 30,000 per month

18 content pieces per month

A balanced mix of designs, edited photos, motion graphics, and reels to support a consistent presence with varied, planned messaging.

Posts — 10 pieces

  • 3 motion graphics posts: Animated visual content for presenting key messages and information.
  • 7 design and photo posts: Static designs, edited photos, or carousels, allocated according to the content plan.

Reels — 8 videos

  • 5 archive-based reels: Existing footage repurposed through editing and visual treatment to support the month’s concepts.
  • 3 newly filmed reels: Original videos produced around the ideas and scripts developed in the content plan.

Best for: Brands seeking a consistent presence with planned messaging and a steady rhythm.

Expanded Content Plan

EGP 45,000 per month

29 content pieces per month

A higher production volume for broader messaging and a more active presence, with a larger allocation of newly filmed reels and motion graphics.

Posts — 15 pieces

  • 6 motion graphics posts: Animated visual content for presenting key messages and information.
  • 9 design and photo posts: Static designs, edited photos, or carousels, allocated according to the content plan.

Reels — 14 videos

  • 8 archive-based reels: Existing footage repurposed through editing and visual treatment to support the month’s concepts.
  • 6 newly filmed reels: Original videos produced around the ideas and scripts developed in the content plan.

Best for: Brands seeking broader messaging and a more active presence through higher content production.

How We Count Content

  • Motion graphics count toward the total post allocation.
  • Carousels are included within the design and photo post allocation.
  • Newly filmed reel quantities refer to completed videos, not filming sessions.
  • Content calendar preparation is included; platform scheduling and publishing are optional.

Optional Services

Available according to the project’s needs and agreed scope of work:

  • Social Media Page Management
  • Community Management:

    Monitoring and responding to messages and comments.

  • Media Buying & Advertising Campaign Management
  • Content Scheduling & Publishing

How We Work

  1. 01

    We define the month’s objectives and pillars.

  2. 02

    We develop ideas, messaging, and visual direction, and prepare the content calendar.

  3. 03

    We write captions, on-visual text, and scripts for reels and motion graphics.

  4. 04

    We produce: design, motion graphics, filming, and editing.

  5. 05

    We deliver the content according to the quantities specified in the selected plan.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between the two plans?

Production volume: 18 pieces in Essential and 29 in Expanded, with more newly filmed reels and motion graphics.

What are “archive-based reels”?

Existing footage repurposed through editing and visual treatment to support the month’s concepts.

Does a filming session count as a content piece?

No. Newly filmed reel quantities refer to completed videos, not filming sessions.

Are carousels and motion graphics counted on top of the posts?

No. Motion graphics count toward the post allocation, and carousels sit within the design and photo allocation.

Are scheduling and publishing included?

Content calendar preparation is included. Scheduling and publishing are optional services.

Can we add page management or ad campaigns?

Yes, as optional services according to the project’s needs and agreed scope of work.
